# Test pe version control - Git-like functionality for prompts

# Initialize repository
pe init
stdout 'Initialized PE repository'
exists .pe/HEAD
exists .pe/refs/heads/main
contains .pe/HEAD 'ref: refs/heads/main'

# First commit
pe add prompt.txt
pe commit -m "Initial prompt version"
stdout 'Created commit'
stdout 'main'
pe log --oneline
stdout 'Initial prompt version'

# Create and switch branch
pe branch create feature/improve-clarity
stdout 'Created branch: feature/improve-clarity'
pe checkout feature/improve-clarity
stdout 'Switched to branch: feature/improve-clarity'
contains .pe/HEAD 'ref: refs/heads/feature/improve-clarity'

# Make changes on branch
cp prompt_v2.txt prompt.txt
pe add prompt.txt
pe commit -m "Improve clarity and add examples"
stdout 'Created commit'

# Show diff
pe diff main
stdout '--- a/prompt.txt'
stdout '+++ b/prompt.txt'
stdout '+Please provide clear, well-structured responses with examples.'

# List branches
pe branch list
stdout '  main'
stdout '* feature/improve-clarity'

# Merge branch
pe checkout main
pe merge feature/improve-clarity
stdout 'Merged feature/improve-clarity -> main'
stdout 'Fast-forward merge'

# Create tag
pe tag v1.0.0 -m "First stable version"
stdout 'Created tag: v1.0.0'
pe tag list
stdout 'v1.0.0'

# Show prompt history
pe log --stat
stdout 'Initial prompt version'
stdout '1 file changed'
stdout 'Improve clarity and add examples'
stdout '1 file changed'

# Revert changes
pe revert HEAD
stdout 'Reverted: Improve clarity and add examples'
pe log --oneline
stdout 'Revert "Improve clarity'
stdout 'Improve clarity'
stdout 'Initial prompt'

# Stash changes
cp prompt_v3.txt prompt.txt
pe stash
stdout 'Saved working directory'
pe stash list
stdout 'stash@{0}:'

# Apply stash
pe stash pop
stdout 'Applied stash@{0}'
contains prompt.txt 'Version 3'

# Show specific version
pe show v1.0.0:prompt.txt
stdout 'You are a helpful AI assistant.'

# Blame/annotation
pe blame prompt.txt
stdout 'v1.0.0.*You are a helpful'
stdout 'feature/improve.*Please provide clear'

# Cherry-pick commit
pe checkout -b hotfix
pe cherry-pick abc123  # Would be actual commit hash
stdout 'Cherry-picked commit'

# Export/import as bundle
pe bundle create my-prompts.bundle --all
stdout 'Created bundle: my-prompts.bundle'
exists my-prompts.bundle

# Clone from bundle
mkdir ../new-repo
cd ../new-repo
pe clone ../my-prompts.bundle
stdout 'Cloned from bundle'
exists .pe
exists prompt.txt

-- prompt.txt --
You are a helpful AI assistant.

-- prompt_v2.txt --
You are a helpful AI assistant.
Please provide clear, well-structured responses with examples.

-- prompt_v3.txt --
You are a helpful AI assistant. Version 3.
Please provide clear, well-structured responses with examples.
Always cite sources when applicable.
